content.overview: Article 118 provides that each House of Parliament may make rules for regulating its procedure and the conduct of its business, subject to the provisions of the Constitution. The President, after consultation with the Chairman of the Council of States and the Speaker of the House of the People, may make rules as to the procedure with respect to joint sittings and communications between the Houses. Until rules are made under this article, the rules of procedure and standing orders in force immediately before commencement with respect to the Legislature of the Dominion of India apply, with modifications and adaptations by the Chairman or Speaker.
content.glance: Each House makes its own rules of procedure (subject to Constitution). President (after consulting Chairman & Speaker) makes rules for joint sittings and inter-House communications.
content.study:
Article 118 is the source of each House’s rule-making power for its own procedure and business. Joint sittings and inter-House communications are under Presidential rules after consultation with both Chair and Speaker. Transitional rules from the Dominion Legislature applied until replaced.

Examination: House autonomy over own rules; Presidential role for joint sittings/communications; subject to Constitution.

sections.heading: Rule-making
sections.body:
1. Each House: rules for its procedure and conduct of business (subject to Constitution).
2. Joint sittings and communications between Houses: President after consulting Chairman and Speaker.
3. Transitional: pre-commencement Dominion Legislature rules with adaptations.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who makes the rules of procedure for the Houses of Parliament?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 118, each House of Parliament may make rules for regulating its procedure and the conduct of its business, subject to the Constitution. For joint sittings of the Houses and communications between the Houses, the President may make rules after consultation with the Chairman of the Council of States and the Speaker of the House of the People.

examTips: Each House makes own rules; President for joint sittings after consultation.

keyTakeaways: Art 118: House rules of procedure; Presidential rules for joint sittings.
